patch_description:
This crossover keeps the efficient causal dual-scale alpha-beta tracker and reversal hysteresis from the current implementation, while incorporating robust local directional evidence inspired by the endpoint trend tracker. The filter uses a robust median first-difference slope over a short recent span, combines it with fast/slow exponential slope states, clips impulsive innovations, and requires directional persistence before accepting small counter-trend moves.

The implementation preserves all public functions, validation behavior, output alignment, output length, basic moving-average mode, and non-finite value handling. Noise-scale updates are performed periodically after warm-up to reduce repeated median/percentile work and improve real-time efficiency.
